**Allowed origins** (worker/src/index.ts, the `cors({ origin: ... })` callback, ~line 20): exactly `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**To add a new custom domain:** edit that same `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` — add a new condition (e.g. `origin === 'https://your-domain.com'` or an `.endsWith(...)` check) inside the `if (...)` block before `return origin;`. Since Hono's `cors` only matches array entries as exact strings, wildcard/custom domains must be added as a condition in this function, not as a list entry (see docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4 "CORS").
